title: sample-list/1: what the files hold, sample by sample
description: The answer of `mzlab-cli sample list --json`: one entry per file, in the order given. An entry is the `samples_list/1` document the site and the app also use (format, bytes, scan, samples with id, name, scans, size, kinds, polarity, rt, tic, why, refused), or, for a file the reader refuses, an `error/1` document. `consistency` (only when the pair disagrees with itself) says the .wiff.scan ends before its index (`short`) or holds sections the index lacks (`unlisted`, a copy made while acquiring), with the numbers it rests on. Exit 1 when a sample or a file is refused or the pair disagrees, 8 when it does and a member was modified in the last `recent_s` seconds (the document stays on stdout in both); a file that is missing or unreadable is one `error/1` (exit 4). Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/samples_cmd.rs.

consistency.description: Present only for a .wiff pair whose .wiff.scan is shorter than its index or holds sections after the indexed part (wiff::completeness).

sections_unlisted.description: Sections of the .wiff.scan after the indexed part that the index does not list.

age_s.description: Seconds since the newest member was modified.

recent_s.description: The threshold: a member modified less than this many seconds ago may still be written (10).
